verse.verse_2: And by the night when it is still (or darkens);
verse.verse_3: Your Lord (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) has neither forsaken you nor hated you.
verse.verse_4: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present (life of this world).
verse.verse_5: And verily, your Lord will give you (all i.e. good) so that you shall be well-pleased.
verse.verse_6: Did He not find you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) an orphan and gave you a refuge?
verse.verse_7: And He found you unaware (of the Quran, its legal laws, and Prophethood, etc.) and guided you?
verse.verse_8: And He found you poor, and made you rich (selfsufficient with selfcontentment, etc.)?
verse.verse_9: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression,
verse.verse_11: And proclaim the Grace of your Lord (i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces).
